name: ClearVisit
description: ClearVisit token resolution: 2 themes × 2 platforms = 4 permutations. Bundled: file references inlined (Resolver §7.1).

primitives.description: Raw values. Never referenced by components for color.

color.$description: Primitive color palette. Generated on a shared OKLCH lightness ladder; never consumed directly by components.

transparent.$description: Fully transparent. Used for ghost/tertiary backgrounds.

blue.$description: Brand primary — 'Harbor blue'. Trust, primary actions, confirmed appointments.

teal.$description: Secondary / accent. Calm highlight moments, secondary data series.

violet.$description: Rescheduled appointments. Extended status hue (assumption: not in original brief's palette list).

slate-alpha.$description: Translucent slate-975 for scrims and shadows.

black-alpha.$description: Translucent black for dark-theme shadows and scrims.

sans.$description: Primary UI family. Atkinson Hyperlegible Next was designed by the Braille Institute for low-vision readers: distinct letterforms (Il1, 0O) reduce misreads of names, times and IDs.

size.$description: Font-size scale. Authored in px for Figma compatibility; converted to rem in CSS so text respects user font-size settings.

line-height.$description: Unitless multipliers of font size (DTCG typography.lineHeight is a number).

typography.$description: Context-free type ramp. Product roles (page title, table cell…) live in the semantic platform layer.

space.$description: 4px base grid (2px half-step for hairline adjustments). Names equal pixel values.

size.$description: Fixed sizes for controls, icons, targets and containers. Names equal pixel values.

dashed.$description: Reserved for tentative/pending holds so pending is distinguishable without color.

shadow.$description: Two-layer shadows (tight contact + soft ambient). 'soft' tuned for light surfaces, 'strong' for dark.

breakpoint.$description: Min-width breakpoints. Patient app is designed at 360–430; admin is designed at ≥1200.

focus.$description: Focus ring thickness (≥2px CSS px for WCAG 2.4.13-style visibility).

indicator.$description: Active tab underline, calendar event status bar.

$root.$description: Focus indicator for every interactive element. Applied as an outline with an offset.

control.$description: Hover/press/selection feedback. Reduced-motion users get duration 0 (see CSS).

disabled-media.$description: Images/avatars inside disabled rows. Never used for text.

button.$description: Primary/secondary/tertiary/destructive buttons. Variant colors come straight from color.action.*; only geometry is tokenised here.

field.$description: Shared by text input, search field and dropdown trigger.

badge.$description: Status badge = icon + label on tinted fill. Colors read directly from color.status.<status>.* (no per-status component tokens; they would duplicate the semantic layer).

time-selector.$description: Time picker list (admin) / wheel (mobile). Slot buttons are a separate mobile component.

availability-card.$description: Search result card that leads with the soonest open time.

time-slot.$description: Bookable time button. Selected = filled + check icon; booked = disabled fill + struck-through time + 'Booked' a11y label.

calendar-event.$description: Event chip. Fill/text/bar come from color.status.<status>.*; pending adds a dashed outline; conflicts add an error outline + icon + 'Conflict' label.

muted.$description: Placeholders, timestamps. Still meets 4.5:1 on default and subtle surfaces.

disabled.$description: Disabled text. Exempt from WCAG 1.4.3 but always paired with a disabled container.

elevated.$description: Menus, modals, sheets. In dark mode elevation is expressed by lightness.

subtle.$description: Table headers, search fields, off-hours calendar cells.

default.$description: Card and container edges. Decorative; containers are also separated by surface color.

strong.$description: Boundaries of interactive controls (inputs, checkboxes, chips). Meets 3:1 (WCAG 1.4.11).

focus.$description: Focus ring color. Meets 3:1 against all surfaces.

hover.$description: Hover fill for rows, list items, ghost controls.

offset.$description: Gap between control and ring so the ring reads on any fill.

status.$description: Appointment statuses. Color is never the only cue: every status ships with a text label and a distinct icon (see $extensions).

available.$description: Open slot a patient can book.

confirmed.$description: Booked and confirmed by practice and patient.

pending.$description: Requested or held; awaiting confirmation. Rendered with dashed outline on calendars.

completed.$description: Visit has happened. De-emphasised on purpose.

cancelled.$description: Cancelled by patient or practice. Time text is struck through.

rescheduled.$description: Moved to a new time; links to the new appointment.

elevation.$description: Theme-aware elevation. Dark theme uses stronger shadows plus lighter surfaces.

platform.description: Density/platform. Orthogonal to theme: no token is defined by both modifiers.

control.$description: Control heights. Mobile = touch-first, desktop = density-first.

touch-target.$description: Minimum hit area. Mobile 48 exceeds WCAG 2.5.8 (24) and matches platform HIG guidance; desktop uses the 24px AA minimum for pointer input.

selection-control.$description: Checkbox/radio visual size (hit area is touch-target).

nav-bar.$description: Mobile bottom nav height / desktop top bar height.

modal.$description: Mobile modals render as bottom sheets (top corners only).

text-style.$description: Role-based type. Same role names on both platforms; values differ by density.

input.$description: Mobile inputs stay at 16px so iOS Safari does not zoom on focus.
